L47: Bibliographic Metadata A search by bibliographic metadata only yields results from the descriptive bibliographic records.

L50: Search by Year Time periods must be entered as 1570-1600. Searching by call number Use right-hand truncation to search by call number, entering the exact wording of the call number from its beginning. By truncating in this way, collective holdings under the same number can be located (for example: Ms CFM). Search Content A search in the content will deliver results from the indexed contents only.
L51: Right Truncation A search for fort will also find forts and fortress. No wildcards (* or ?) can be used.
